card.name: Section openers before a drug or study
card.fires_on: Words that start a label statement and come right before a drug name, condition, or data term: colons after 'dosage for' or 'including', 'study' after 'controlled', and the start of 'Accurate' or 'Insufficient'.

modes.label: Colon before a list
modes.description: A colon that introduces a condition, indication, or list item.

modes.label: Study word
modes.description: The word study or studies after a trial descriptor, before a drug name.

modes.label: Start of a statement
modes.description: The opening piece of a sentence-initial word such as Accurate or Insufficient in a label section.
